_comment: Everything the dashboard's Apply kit lets you copy. Edit any value, save, and refresh the dashboard (no restart needed). Lines starting with EDIT ME are placeholders: replace them with your real answer. This repo is public: anything you put here is visible to anyone, so keep salary numbers and your phone number out of commits.

answers.label: Where are you based?
answers.value: Ontario, Canada (Eastern Time). Open to remote, hybrid or onsite roles in Canada, and remote roles in the US.

answers.label: Work authorization
answers.value: EDIT ME: e.g. Canadian citizen / permanent resident / work permit. For US roles: whether you need sponsorship or can work as a contractor.

answers.label: Salary expectation
answers.value: EDIT ME: a range in CAD or USD

answers.label: Years of experience
answers.value: Recent graduate (Diploma in Computer Networking, St. Clair College, 2025) with about 2 years as a software engineering co-op and part-time engineer at DGR Inc., plus freelance full-stack work since January 2026.

answers.label: Full-time or contract?
answers.value: Looking for full-time new grad or entry-level roles; open to contract.

summaries.infrastructure: Recent graduate with two years of production engineering at DGR Inc., where I resolved 100+ production issues using metrics, logs and traces (cutting MTTR by 35%) and built Python and Terraform CI/CD integrations that cut release times by 70%. On my own I built statewatch, a drift detector that compares live GCP state with Terraform state and fails CI on critical drift, and PreScale, which finds saturation and latency regressions under load and gates CI on capacity thresholds.
summaries.backend: Recent graduate who builds backend services in Go and Python. At DGR Inc. I built Python backend services and internal deployment tooling for production systems; on my own I built Toss, a real-time Go service on an event-driven SSE architecture with AES-GCM encryption, rate limiting and reconnect with state recovery, used by 50+ people.
summaries.fullstack: Recent graduate who ships across the stack in Go, Python and TypeScript. As a freelance engineer I own a client's booking platform end to end in React and Next.js, raised booking conversion from 1.5% to 4.2%, and integrated the ElevenLabs API to add a voice AI feature that grew sales by 50%.
